regimens.dose_text: Initial starting dose: 1 mg daily. Gradually increase by 2 mg increments at intervals of 3 to 5 days, up to a total of 6 to 10 mg daily in 3 divided doses with meals. Avoid in elderly patients (>65 years) due to high risk of acute delirium, confusion, memory impairment, and urinary retention (Beer's Criteria).
